meta.case: the poll author closes the poll

semantics.object_ref: the poll's create message, addressed by (envelope.source, pollTerminate.targetSentTimestamp)
semantics.target_ref: pollTerminate.targetSentTimestamp (+ envelope.source as the poll author)
semantics.actor: envelope.source — Signal only honours terminate from the poll's author
semantics.notes: A close is a source event only. It never settles the matter the poll was about, and it carries no final tally — closing state must be reconciled with observed votes.
semantics.today: parse_event returns None — no poll branch
